surrounding.trailing:
The Door step banking service can be offered by the bank through any of the following means.
By Banks own regular staff
Outsourcing the operations to a Cash management vendor who have national / regional presence with a good track record. The outsourcing to such vendor will be governed by the outsourcing policy of the bank.
Through banking correspondents empaneled with the bank.
Services provided through outsourcing or through banking correspondents will be through a mutually signed agreement detailing the terms and conditions including charges for executing these services, turnaround time.

llm_analyze_result.description: This table outlines the savings amounts offered for different types of cash services under operating guidelines, specifically for individuals, senior citizens/differently abled persons, and current account customers. The rows represent two distinct service types: 'Cash Pickup' and 'Cash Delivery', while the columns indicate varying savings tiers based on customer categories. For both services, individuals and senior citizens/differently abled persons receive a fixed savings amount of 20,000 per instance, whereas current account customers are entitled to 5 lacs per instance. This structure suggests a tiered benefit system where account type influences the level of financial incentive. The data is subject to change according to bank policy, as noted by the accompanying footnote. The table supports the context of door-step banking services and their operational flexibility, which can be executed by bank staff, vendors, or correspondents under agreed terms.
